BiblicalUsage: In the Old Testament, ʼĕvilîy is the word for silly, foolish; hence (morally) impious. In Zechariah 11:15, the text says "Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd."
TheologicalSignificance: I take ʼĕvilîy as it stands: silly, foolish; hence impious.
